name: accounted
description: Official Accounted plugin: Swedish double-entry bookkeeping flows for your AI agent. Connects your ledger over MCP and ships short workflow skills (daily bookkeeping, health check, month close, VAT, payroll, year-end) that work from the company's live data and load Swedish accounting knowledge from the product when needed. Every write is staged for your approval; nothing is booked on its own.

interface.shortDescription: Swedish bookkeeping flows on your own ledger, every write staged for your approval
